name: Nirwana Beach and Resort
detail: The property was beautiful with everything taken care of. The location is great within Candidasa area and their free shuttle is an added advantage with the stay. The breakfast is a excellent and the most impressive thing is the service offerred by each and every staff right from when you enter the resort till you leave.

name: Tonys Villas & Resort, Seminyak - Bali
detail: I used Tonis Villa 7 years ago and liked it so much that I came back again. There are 3 swimming pools and the space is large, making it nice for walking. The staff is really friendly, especially Hari who is very kind!! The accommodation is completely clean, spacious, and it's a private place, so it was nice to come out at night for some relaxation. The rates weren't cheap since it was peak season, but I was satisfied. I suddenly got sick and went to the emergency room, and the staff introduced me to a hospital and called a taxi for me. It seems that if you catch Bali Belly, they will call a doctor to your resort. Overall, the system is good, the staff is friendly, the bed is very comfortable, and it's located in a good spot for getting around Seminyak. The beach is also relatively close. I highly recommend it.

name: Nikhila Seminyak
detail: A nice location, 1.4 kilometers from Seminyak Beach, it's a pleasant walk where you can explore the unique street shops that have a strong artistic vibe; the hotel room is clean and sanitary, the pool is small and exquisite, and I think the breakfast options in the package are of high quality. This price is unbeatable! We stayed for two days, and it exceeded our expectations significantly.

name: Villa Kayu Raja
detail: The employees here are very friendly, attentive, and patient. My parents and I had a wonderful holiday here, and I would choose this place again when I come back to Bali. Since it was during the Spring Festival, the lobby celebrated the Chinese New Year and displayed Chinese blue and white porcelain, which was very thoughtful. The breakfast was very hearty, especially the fried noodles that were delicious. It took about 40 minutes to drive from the airport. There are convenience stores nearby, and you can use Alipay. The transportation here is convenient; right across the street is the popular 32do café, and it's a 20-minute walk to Seminyak Village, with lush greenery along the way. It’s also a 20-minute walk to the beach, with various small shops along the route. The room has three levels; the second floor is the bedroom, the first floor is the living room, and the sunken area has a large swimming pool. The pool is very big, and the water is changed every afternoon, so you can swim after coming back from outside. The living room is semi-open, which means there can be some mosquitoes, but the hotel staff provided some mosquito incense to keep them away.

name: Munduk Moding Plantation
detail: I am in my 50s and have become healthier after finishing breast cancer treatment five years ago. This time, I visited this place with an old high school friend, determined to forget about my family for a moment and not lift a finger. The fresh air on the mountain, the constantly changing sky, the sounds of various birds, and the night crickets made every moment beautiful. Just enjoying the view from the hot water jacuzzi available 24 hours a day and the pool at a comfortable temperature brought me happiness. One night, I enjoyed the hot water jacuzzi while being lightly drizzled with rain, feeling as if I was in paradise. The traditional Balinese massage was also excellent, and on the second day, I felt all the stress from my body and mind had completely vanished. However, what made this place even more special was the people. By simply leaving a message via KakaoTalk to Arick and Gargita about the breakfast location and menu, as well as requests for ginger and turmeric juice or lemongrass tea, they would prepare everything meticulously and organize the daily schedule as soon as they confirmed. I asked them to do minor cleaning tasks like arranging towels during the yoga session from 8 to 9 in the morning, and it was even better to have breakfast in a completely tidy house. Every staff member made a concerted effort to find ways to accommodate any requests I made. The only downside was that conducting morning yoga on the second floor of the restaurant meant there was some background noise. Looking back, I regret not sharing my preferences and requests sufficiently with the staff. If you plan to visit this place, I recommend organizing your inclinations and requests in easy English ahead of time, such as whether you prefer a quiet environment and what services you want. After exchanging contact information with the staff locally, if you send them your preferences right away, it will be easier to understand each other's needs and communicate more comfortably. If you want to experience not only beautiful scenery but also warm and attentive butler service, this is undoubtedly the place to be. Thanks to Arick and Gargita, this trip became one of the happiest moments of my life.

name: Chapung Sebali Resort
detail: The breakfast is delicious, and the Jungle Fish restaurant inside is very tasty too. They provide a shuttle to the city, so we were able to do all the shopping near the palace (like Indian Sol, Ticket to the Moon, the palace, and temple visits, etc.). Most things can be done within the resort, and since I visited in September, there weren't too many people. The pool is very clean, which is great, and you can refer to other guest reviews for room views and pool views. The massage services inside are quite nice as well. We came with a one-year-old child and had a relaxing time as a family.

name: Adi Dharma Hotel Kuta
detail: I arrived at the hotel in the morning and thought I would just check my luggage, but I was grateful that I could check in right away and was shown to my room. The room was spacious and clean, and there were no issues with the shower. Bali has large resort hotels, but there are also many charming smaller hotels that are reasonably priced, so it can be difficult to choose one, but choosing this hotel was the right decision! The staff were all smiling and friendly, and the breakfast buffet was delicious.

name: Pandawa All Suite Hotel
detail: The accommodation is really nice, right??? I was worried because the reviews were mixed, but even though I checked in in the evening, the staff were super friendly and gave us guidance. Since we were guests, they gave us discount coupons for the restaurant in the hotel, and the carbonara with beef was really delicious, haha. The cocktails were 2 for 1, so it came out to a total of 24,000 won. The place may be a bit old, but it was very clean, the air conditioning worked well, and overall it was just great.

name: Kamini Legian Hotel
detail: I was a bit surprised that the front was half-exposed outdoors (no glass) and that there was no elevator when I arrived, but it wasn't an issue since the staff helped carry my luggage. The location is very good, as it's a little set back from Legian Street, so the noise is not a problem. Also, there are exchange offices and convenience stores nearby. I noticed that the shower's hot water flow was a bit lacking, but it was manageable with some adjustment in height. Considering the price, I can definitely recommend this hotel.

name: The Sanyas Suite Seminyak
detail: The hotel environment is very good, with a private courtyard feel and a high cost-performance ratio. Although there are many bars nearby, it is very quiet inside the room. The pool water seems to be automatically changed every day, and the bathroom has an outdoor design, complete with a bathtub. The staff's service is particularly good; they will bring breakfast to the courtyard every day, and if there's a problem, you can call using the phone in the room, and they respond quickly. The only downside is that even with some mosquito repellent, I still ended up with several bites, and the Wi-Fi signal in the room is average; I hope it can be improved.
